newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen rebounding after election news.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen rebounding after election news.

text.p: French stocks were expected to rebound on Tuesday from Monday's one percent fall after President Jacques Chirac confirmed on Monday night that he would dissolve parliament and call a snap election in May-June.

"We expect a small rebound," said one trader. "The only thing we can foresee is that the markets will be very nervous." He and other traders said the bourse would be driven by polls from here to the election.
* The CAC-40 April futures contract traded on GLOBEX was 17 points higher at 2,539 at 0728 GMT. The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 24.89 points or 0.98 percent at 2,522.67 on Monday.
